notes: Cover date January 14, 2019. Skipped: about 15 claims without a number or without a date, for example 'digital wallets could upend traditional banks within five years', 'each of these platforms will create multiple trillions in market capitalization over the next decade', the Bitcoin section (no numeric forecast), CRISPR market-opportunity sizes without a year, and third-party figures (Amazon 3,000 stores by 2021; China AI mandate by 2025; disease spending by 2025 from Grand View Research and others).
